notes:
Summary: Stonegate is a compliance analytics vendor processing bank regulatory filings. Strong preference for a Private (VPC) deployment; upstream data includes PII and regulated financial content. They are in an active security evaluation; target is a Q2 procurement decision.

Key security asks & technical posture: 
- In-transit: require mutual TLS between Redwood control plane and customer VPC endpoints for any control traffic. Service-to-service mTLS inside VPC preferred. Customer will terminate external TLS at their ALB and expects Redwood agent to present certs for backend connections.
- At-rest: all model cache and persisted artifacts must be encrypted; bring-your-own-key (BYOK) required. Customer explicitly asked for HSM-backed KMS (FIPS 140-2) or equivalent cloud KMS with HSM key origin.
- Key rotation: must support automated key rotation without losing access to cached KV entries; require documentation of rotation process, backward compatibility window, and rotation cadence.
- Secrets mgmt: integrate with HashiCorp Vault or cloud secrets manager; secrets should not be stored in plaintext on disk; ephemeral tokens + short TTLs desired.
- Audit logging: immutable audit logs for inference requests and model version rollouts; retention policy configurable (default 7 years for certain records); integration hook to their SIEM (Splunk) required.
- Data residency: primary storage and model artifacts must reside in US regions; cannot replicate to non-US without explicit legal approval.
- Network: prefer VPC peering over public endpoints; if NAT required, must support static egress IPs for firewall whitelisting.
- Compliance: require SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO27001 controls for hosting; security questionnaire completed (attached).

POC specifics and asks: 
- POC scope: ingest 1M documents, run embeddings + reranking pipeline. Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 220ms for search rerank requests; throughput target 120 reqs/s during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to pay premium for private tenancy and HSM-backed KMS but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token/unit cost.

Quotes & friction: 
- "We need absolute control of key custody; no third-party key escrow unless HSM-managed." - Head of Infosec
- Legal flagged long-term log retention (7+ years) — potential negotiation point.
